Name: Farmable Pam for BFAV
Author: AelaanBluewood
Description:
[b][color=#e06666]This mod only works if you have [b]Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety installed![/b][/color]

1.5 update - please use BFAV unofficial update for 1.5 by kelvinparkour found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296?tab=posts]here in the comment thread of Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety

[color=#a64d79]
[/color][/url][/b][b][u][color=#f4cccc]Installation
[/color][/u][/b]Either use the vortex mod manager
or download the zip file and copy its content into your stardew valley mods folder.

[color=#f4cccc][b][u]How to use this mod
[/u][/b][/color]You need to have a Barn (Barn, Big Barn, Deluxe Barn, all works).
You can now buy a "Pam" clone at Marnies Animal Shop for 2000g.
A Pam gives you 1 Beer a day (that you can collect with the Milk pail) and has a chance to give you a Pale Ale instead. Both can be of all qualities, from normal to Iridium. Having a high friendship level greatly influence the product quality.
